role: The immediate-mode vertex buffer: every world, entity and GUI quad in 1.7.10 flows through it as rawBuffer int vertices (position, texture, colour, brightness, normal) that draw() uploads to GL.
scope_reason: The C mesher and rasterizers reproduce the Tessellator's vertex layout and arithmetic because the pixel gates compare the quads it produces.

members.name: rawBuffer
members.note: struct rb_tess keeps the same 8 ints per vertex (t->raw); the mesher contract is MeshProbe's layout

members.name: color
members.note: setColorRGBA clamps then packs little endian as the oracle does (render_blocks.c comment)

members.name: hasColor
members.note: carried as flags in struct rb_tess and read back by raster.c draw_section

members.name: addedVertices
members.note: buffer-growth bookkeeping; the native buffer is fixed capacity

members.name: drawMode
members.note: the ported paths draw quads only; the mesher asserts the quad shape

members.name: normal
members.note: the packed normal exists in the mesher's vertex layout and raster_hand.c reproduces setNormal's signed-byte packing

members.name: instance
members.note: the singleton becomes one struct rb_tess per mesher

members.name: bufferSize
members.note: fixed capacity in C; Java grows the array

members.name: draw
members.note: no GL upload exists; the consumers read t->raw directly (draw_section in raster.c, the rasterizers' clip stage), which is the SPEC's decision that GL is the numerical oracle, not something we emit

members.name: getVertexState
members.note: the vertex-state capture-and-sort of translucent quads becomes sorting the section's quads by distance (water_quad_compare, water_quad_distance)

members.name: setVertexState
members.note: same replacement

members.name: reset
members.note: start resets the emitter state

members.name: startDrawing
members.note: non-quad draw modes are outside the ported render types

members.name: setColorOpaque_F
members.note: casts each channel with (int)(f * 255.0F) as Java does

members.name: setColorRGBA_F
members.note: the C helper takes three channels; the alpha path is folded into the callers

members.name: setColorRGBA
members.note: tess_set_color_rgba is static in render_blocks.c; tess_set_color_opaque delegates to it

members.name: func_154352_a
members.note: the signed-byte colour path is not ported; no ported render type reaches it; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: addVertex
members.note: the double-to-float rounding at store time is reproduced

members.name: setColorRGBA_I
members.note: the alpha variant is not ported; no ported render type reaches it; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: setNormal
members.note: setNormal's signed-byte packing (x * 127) is reproduced in raster_hand.c's hand path; the mesher's normal packing lives in its vertex layout

members.name: addTranslation
members.note: no ported path uses it

notes: The Tessellator's vertex layout is pinned by csrc/tests/test_meshes.c against the oracle's MeshProbe dumps (out/java/meshes/), which is stronger evidence than any frame gate for the emitter arithmetic. raster_worldfx.c and raster_particles.c reproduce the same double-rounding conventions for their own quads. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data. Formerly listed as missing: draw()'s GL upload: intentionally absent; the C consumers read the raw vertex buffer directly (SPEC: GL is the numerical oracle, not something we emit). func_154352_a and setColorRGBA_I: signed-byte and alpha colour paths no ported render type reaches. addTranslation: no ported path uses it.
